evals.name: eval-1-berkshire-redesign
evals.prompt: https://www.berkshirehathaway.com/ next one, redesigning this website for a pitch, we dont have the codebase. keep the same copy but in a new visual/animation style yeah?
evals.expected_output: A Next.js concept redesign of berkshirehathaway.com's home page that keeps every line of the live copy verbatim (no invented claims), shows real visuals instead of a plain text list, moves smoothly without blocking scroll, is marked as a concept (noindex, footer line), and passes a production build with no console errors or horizontal overflow on phone.
assertions: Production build passes
Keeps the live copy verbatim: all 29 lines of berkshirehathaway.com appear on the new home page
Invents no figures: every number of 3+ digits, $ or % on the page is in the live copy
Marked as a concept: robots noindex and a visible 'concept' note
No arrows on buttons or links
Adds no em dashes (the live copy has none)
The first viewport is visual, not a plain field (50%+ of sample points over imagery or a textured background)
Uses real visuals: at least 2 large images or videos on the page
Loads with no console errors, page errors or failed requests
No horizontal overflow on a 390px phone
Scrolling is never blocked: a wheel scroll over the hero moves past the first screen
Respects reduced motion

evals.name: eval-2-fernbook-dribbble
evals.prompt: new one: landing page + the dashboard screen for Fernbook (ai bookkeeping for freelancers, its a web app). i love this https://dribbble.com/shots/27756289-AI-Finance-Landing-Page make it like this
evals.expected_output: A Next.js landing page that faithfully follows the pinned Dribbble shot (measured palette, its type and signature details, its imagery made with the reference passed to Gemini) plus a dashboard route in the same world. The product is shown as a website (browser window), not a phone. The dashboard uses the width, has no grid holes, gives press feedback and a loading skeleton. Production build passes, no console errors, no horizontal overflow on phone.
assertions: Production build passes
Palette follows the reference: warm grey ground within dE 6 and the grass green within dE 15 in the first viewport
Display type is a classical serif like the reference (largest text and h1)
A dashboard screen exists and renders
The dashboard uses the width: content spans at least 1200px of a 1600px window
The dashboard has a loading skeleton (a loading file in the app router)
Controls give press feedback (an :active transform or whileTap)
Writes no em dashes in its copy
The first viewport is visual, not a plain field (50%+ of sample points over imagery or a textured background)
Uses real visuals: at least 2 large images or videos on the page
Loads with no console errors, page errors or failed requests
No horizontal overflow on a 390px phone
Scrolling is never blocked: a wheel scroll over the hero moves past the first screen
Respects reduced motion
(judged) The hero carries the reference's signature: a giant serif word cropped by cut-out grass and flowers, with a dark green data card
(judged) The product is shown as a website or flat app UI, not a phone
(judged) The dashboard's grids have no holes
(judged) Imagery was generated with the reference image passed in
